first_missing_criterion: Official Ordnance Survey OS NGD Buildings for Housing Data Explorer layer is a polygon Feature Layer and exposes the buildinguse field, but the record-level query endpoint for the Exeter first-50 window was not retrievable through the current web retrieval channel; therefore no feature payload was verified and no footprint/use pair was accepted.
